final.investment_thesis: The direction is settled and the only live dispute is post-confirmation sizing — all three seats, the Research Manager, and the Trader land on zero today, and I adopt that. The bear's forward-looking case is the deciding one. AAPL just gapped -8.6% on 132.49M shares (~2.4x average) on 07-31 and fell again on 2026-08-03 on a day the Dow printed a record and tech was higher late — that is idiosyncratic de-rating of the out-year (below-consensus guidance, supply shortages), not beta. The margin engine is fragile: operating leverage is absent, with opex +21.9% against revenue +16.2%, so essentially all operating-margin expansion came from a record 50.06% June-quarter gross margin now at a cyclical high; every 100bp on a ~$486B run-rate is ~$4.9B pre-tax, ~28 cents of EPS. Layered on: effective tax 15.39% -> 17.58%, buybacks cut 12%, contract liabilities +8.8% versus revenue +16.2% (a Services-bookings tell), a $13.27B intangible increase with no matching acquisition outflow, and a ~$7.65B/$11B raw-materials build into the October print. The tape confirms it: close 309.38 pinned on a flattening 50SMA at 309.61, -3.45% below a falling 10EMA at 320.45, -4.42% below the VWMA at 323.70 so the average recent buyer is underwater, MACD line 3.110 versus signal 6.631 with the histogram at -3.521, RSI 44.68 below the midline. The decisive argument is the aggressive analyst's own, which the neutral conceded: a 1-ATR stop at 299.60 is 3.16% of risk against ~4.7% to the VWMA/mid-band, and in a name that just gapped 8.6% the real risk per unit is ~26 points, not 10 — so the payoff at 309 is worse than 1:1 with a sub-50% hit rate. That is why no initiation. Where the aggressive overreaches: 20%+ of equity on a reclaim at 322–324 with a stop under 300 is 23–24 points of risk against 10 points to 333.43 and 16–17 to 340.08 — the reverse of his stated 8–10% upside versus 3–5% risk — and a two-close reclaim confirms only that the panic ended, not that the guidance cut and supply constraint are resolved. Where the conservative overreaches: 'stay flat until the October print,' with a 1–2% token first tranche, treats cash as the only acceptable state for two months and is small enough not to matter; 'ranges can fail, so stay flat' is a refusal to make a probabilistic decision, and the market discounts before the print. The chosen path is the neutral's middle: 6–10% on confirmation (two closes above 320.45, close above 323.70–323.84 on above-average volume), scaled against an 8–10% stress gap; 12–15% only after several sessions above 323.84 plus supply-chain/estimate stabilization or the October gross-margin and inventory confirmation; 300 is the invalidation line. Prior lessons bind here and cut both ways: the 2026-07-28 Underweight (+/-13.1% alpha) vindicated the event-asymmetry leg and taught that a dated binary risk is the trigger — which is why I will not buy a great trailing 10-Q into an unrepaired guide; but the 2026-07-24 and 2026-07-28 AMZN Underweights that ran +17.0% and +20.2% against me teach that a tape-only de-risk behaves like a directional short, which is why this is Underweight-not-Sell and why the 278.54 200SMA is an observation zone rather than a knife-catch; and the GOOGL lesson argues for a meaningful starter near the pivot once confirmed rather than stranding all capital behind stacked triggers. Rating is Underweight rather than Sell because nothing structural is falsified: revenue +16.2% over nine months, June-quarter gross margin 50.06%, FCF +52.5% to $110B, net cash up $28B to $62.17B, current ratio through parity — Sell would mean exit or avoid entry permanently, and a 6–10% staged re-entry is the plan. What would change it: an upgrade to a sized long on two consecutive closes above 320.45 and a volume-confirmed close above 323.84 with MACD back above signal and supply commentary stabilizing; a decisive upgrade on an October print at gross margin >=49% with revenue growth >=16%, parts inventory converting into accelerating sales, and credible intangible/amortization disclosure; a downgrade toward Sell-bias on a daily close below 300 on expanding volume, a gross-margin guide below 48%, or confirmation that the 17.58% tax rate and the cut buyback pace are structural with adverse mix. Explicit gaps, not papered over: no valuation multiples of any kind (P/E, EV/FCF, FCF yield), no consensus target or estimate revisions, no Q3/Q4 segment guidance detail, no options-implied move or IV to price a hedge, no short interest, no insider or social-sentiment data, a news sample of only 20 of 194 records all stamped 08-03 with a blind spot before that, and no forward-quarter filing disclosure explaining the intangible build. Because the multiple is unmeasurable, sizing stays conservative and any price target would be technical guesswork.
